title: The. 7. Sermon vpon the first Chapter, which is alſo the firſt vpon the ſecond Chapter.

segments.text:
22 For I vvas vnknovvne by face to the Churches of
Ievvrie that vvere in Chriſt.
23 Saue onely they had heard ſay, hee that erevvhiles
perſecuted vs, doth novv preach the fayth vvhich
he had deſtroyed for a •ime.
24 And they glorified God in mee.
